page.content:
First and largest language edition, launched 15 January 2001.

How English Wikipedia connects

  • Topic: Wikipedia — English Wikipedia is the original language edition of the project.
  • Topic: Five pillars — The Five pillars are English Wikipedia's short statement of principle.
  • Topic: Featured article — Featured articles are English Wikipedia's highest content designation.
  • Faction: Arbitration Committee — ArbCom is English Wikipedia's binding conduct panel.
  • Work: Wikimedia Commons — Commons supplies freely licensed files to English Wikipedia articles.

What is English Wikipedia?

English Wikipedia is the original edition and still the largest. Its policies, featured-article process, and arbitration culture were copied, then localized, by other languages.

Key threads lead to Wikipedia, Five pillars, Featured article, Arbitration Committee and Wikimedia Commons.
